raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since batch 13 the new 'v2' collector writes txn_ts exactly 6 hours late. In the samples, v2 rows at 12:xx sit between legacy neighbours at 06:xx by txn_id, so their true times are 06:xx. Late-evening v2 rows therefore spill past midnight into the next date. That explains the 00:00-06:00 rows on 01-18 and the 33 rows on 01-19, which are all early-morning timestamps. Subtracting 6 hours for v2 rows restores the correct timestamps and txn_date.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
